Preserve unavailable telemetry and financial outcomes as unknown; retain aggregate commission as unattributed. Route future implementation only after ownership, isolation, deterministic validation, rollback, deduplication, security, attribution, and measurement evidence are documented.

Continue the existing owner-gap records for complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net. Verify execution ownership and attach dated preview/build, launch-readiness, compliance, security, measurement, and rollback evidence by 2026-09-30T17:00:00Z. Preserve parked/private status; do not publish, deploy, alter DNS, configure analytics, monetize, or spend.

Continue existing measurement, finance reconciliation, legal/security evidence, launch-readiness evidence, and failure repair-or-close work. Do not retry unchanged failures or create duplicate requests. Before any future requeue, require dated ownership, root cause, isolated validation, rollback, deduplication, release, security, attribution, and measurement evidence.

Retain repository and CRO opportunities as deferred research only. Lab results do not establish production fit, dependency approval, security clearance, measurement readiness, revenue impact, or causal lift. Do not install dependencies, dispatch prototypes, deploy, spend, or add telemetry this cycle.

Do not access credentials or private containers, alter permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, exploit targets, or conduct outreach.

Continue the existing period-aligned revenue, attribution, and cost reconciliation only. Preserve aggregate provider commission as unattributed and missing costs, budgets, commitments, and learning thresholds as unknown. Do not claim site revenue, margin, ROI, payback, forecast, budget capacity, or causal lift.
